title: Secret Lair Drop Series: Doctor Who: Regeneration

paragraphs.text: Doctor Who : Regeneration is a drop in the Secret Lair product range and a continuation of the alternate art Secret Lair Drop Series . It was available for purchase from the Wizards of the Coast webshop secretlair.wizards.com from December 11, 2023 till January 8, 2024.

This drop is the third drop to accompany the Universes Beyond Doctor Who set, celebrating the 60th anniversary of the British Doctor Who series. The two earlier drops had been released on October 2, 2023. Doctor Who: Regeneration focusses on the Fourteenth Doctor and the Fifteenth Doctor , who didn't appear in the original Doctor Who Commander decks. The release of the drop was time after the screening of the 2023 60th Anniversary specials of the series, that featured both Doctors.

With a near-identical appearance to his tenth incarnation , the Fourteenth Doctor embraces having a second chance with his old face, and responds to all calls of adventure. Energetic and curious, but also sentimental and compassionate, this incarnation of the Doctor battles the Daleks before eventually reuniting with his old companion Donna Noble for new adventures, all while trying to unravel the mystery of his "new" appearance. The Fourteenth Doctor eventually bigenerates into his fifteenth incarnation .
As an extra, the drop comes with a surprise bonus card.
